description: This file contains the implementation of a file system event watcher for macOS using the FSEvents API, encapsulated within the CoalescingFSEventsWatcher class. It manages event streams, handles event coalescing, and invokes callbacks on file system changes.

classes.name: CoalescingFSEventsWatcher
classes.description: A Swift class that watches file system events on specified paths, coalesces rapid changes to reduce callback invocations, and executes user-defined callbacks upon detected changes.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of CoalescingFSEventsWatcher with specified paths, queue label, coalescing delay, notification predicate, and change callback.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Stops the watcher and releases resources when the instance is deallocated.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the file system event stream to begin monitoring specified paths.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the event stream and releases resources.

methods.name: handleEvents
methods.description: Internal method invoked when file system events occur, performs coalescing, and triggers the onChange callback after a delay.
